top_signals.title: World Running Short of Supertankers Threatens Long-Haul Oil Flow
top_signals.summary: The soaring cost of moving oil around the world is making some long-distance crude trades uneconomical, threatening to disrupt flows at a time when fuel markets have never been tighter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Burglary hits moving BNSF train as container catches fire in Riverside
top_signals.summary:
The Los Angeles-to-Chicago train carried mixed freight when a container caught fire during a burglary. Riverside and Colton firefighters extinguished the blaze before BNSF Police took over the investigation.
